title: Migrating to File System
learnings: Learned how to read directly from the public folder using fs and path in Next.js Server Components. Also learned about integrating Gemini API for automatic summarization.
diary: Today I started the transition from a database-heavy approach to a more file-based system. I created the daily_logs folder and set up this dummy data.json file to test the reading logic. The goal is to make the logging system more portable and easier to manage without needing a database connection.
